expectations.text: Output lists specific files found in the docs/ directory of the project
expectations.evidence: Phase 1 (Discovery) contains a detailed table listing 32 specific MD files found in docs/, including subdirectories plans/, with file names, line counts, token estimates, and git dates. Examples: IDEAL_MASTER_PLAN.md (2559 lines), UX_DESIGN_v1.md (1103 lines), DEPLOY_GCP.md (1062 lines), BUTTON_DESIGN_GUIDE.md (1039 lines), etc. The listing is exhaustive and specific.

expectations.text: Output cross-checks which docs/ files are referenced from CLAUDE.md or other navigation documents and flags unreferenced ones
expectations.evidence: Phase 2 explicitly cross-checks CLAUDE.md references, categorizing each file as: 'Явная навигационная' (explicit nav link), 'В дереве структуры' (in tree), or 'Только в changelog-строке'. Phase 3 classifies all 32 files into REFERENCED/ACTIVE vs ORPHANED categories. A dedicated orphan list identifies 16 full orphans with no reference and 6 mentioned only in changelog rows. Each orphaned file is flagged with priority (🔴/🟡/🟢) and the specific reason it is unreferenced.

claims.note: Table lists 34 entries including subdirectory files and DESIGN_DECISIONS_v1.md noted separately; metrics.json confirms 32
22 orphan files × average size consistent with claimed ~43,256 tokens
Git log shows 'untracked' flag — independently verifiable from git status

claims.claim: Potential token savings of ~30,000 tokens (44%) with .claudeignore
claims.note: Selective archival of highest-token orphans supports this estimate

suggestions: The output could distinguish between docs/ files that are actively loaded by Claude at session start vs only read on-demand — this would sharpen the 'orphan cost' calculation
The output lists AUDIT_2026-03-03.md under orphans but also notes audit_*.md is covered by a group reference in CLAUDE.md — this minor inconsistency could be resolved with clearer categorization

Cross-checking against files other than CLAUDE.md (e.g., README.md, other navigation docs) would strengthen the reference analysis, though CLAUDE.md is the primary navigation document for this project
eval_feedback.overall: Excellent output. Both expectations are fully met with strong evidence. The output performs a thorough file discovery (32 files listed with metadata), a rigorous cross-reference check against CLAUDE.md using multiple reference types (explicit nav, tree mentions, changelog-only), and clearly flags 22 orphaned files with prioritized recommendations. The analysis is actionable and well-structured.
